notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hi, an update with some fixes is out. Thanks for everybody who has been letting me know.[/p][p]
- Underwater world: fixed underwater storage container quest description is wrong and the quest never completes.
- Volcanic world: fixed an issue that when you cancel iron ingot crafting that doesn't cost coal you still get coal.
- Volcanic world: added a potential workaround fix for a rare issue that some players seem to possibly be experiencing where building the boat/ship won't complete their corresponding quests (I wasn't able to replicate this but either way it should be solved now).[/p]

notes.title: The Second Part of Grand Emprise Is Available Now & Read Developer Note
notes.content:
[h3]Grand Emprise 2: Portals Apart is now available to purchase and play![/h3][p]The game price is $10 on launch, as it's a bit smaller than the first game.[/p][p]If you are not sure, please try the free demo on the page![/p][p]I hope you enjoy the game![/p][p]P.S. If you find any bugs, I'll do my best to fix them right away, just ping me on [url="https://discord.gg/f4m8NQ2kP8"]Discord[/url] or open a [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2722610/discussions/"]Steam discussion[/url] post![/p][p][/p][p]I want to tell you a bit about this franchise and the game,[/p][p]Grand Emprise is a big passion of mine, I love the idea of combining a variety of different ideas into one crazy adventure (similar to It Takes Two or Split Fiction, but with a survival crafting aspect twist).[/p][p]Not many developers would dare take on making such a game with so much variety, as the development takes a long time, and many people still complain ("asset flip" "not enough polish" "too linear"), but I think those who truly seek a survival crafting adventure will enjoy it, just as I did when playing through the game.[/p][p]At the end the truth is, if I don't make these type of games, nobody else will. So I feel like I have a duty to do it, as I very much enjoy these type of games and wish there'd be more.[/p][p]Because the game is a bit shorter than the first, and that we wanted to make sure everybody would be happy with the game, we priced it very low, although it is probably underpriced a bit.[/p][p]If this second part receives enough support I plan to make a third part.
I have many more ideas for this franchise, but it depends on player interest.
If you are a publisher and want to support the creation of a third part (a multiplayer one), please reach out.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722610/Grand_Emprise_2_Portals_Apart/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
